name: granvl
description: Build, deploy, A/B test and optimize landing pages and paid campaigns on granvl — hosting, first-party analytics and privacy-first lead delivery, driven from your AI agent.

interface.shortDescription: Landing pages, A/B tests and ad campaigns your agent builds and optimizes.
interface.longDescription: granvl is an AI-native landing-page and analytics platform. Connect it and your agent can create funnels, write and publish page variants, split traffic, read first-party conversion analytics joined to ad spend, and build paused Google, Meta and Microsoft campaigns — while lead contact details go straight from the visitor's browser to your CRM, never through granvl.
